findings.summary: crates/athena-core/src/run/send_back.rs is not among the reading's deliverables
findings.evidence: A change outside the listed deliverables widens the scope.

findings.summary: send_back.rs is changed but is not an expected deliverable (Athena's own finding); the plan already justifies it, so this only asks that the change description say so
findings.evidence: send_back.rs:67 holds the private function, and its only callers are send_back.rs:26, :45 and the test at :726-730. The plan moves the body unchanged and keeps the test. Athena flagged the file as outside the deliverables, so the verifier will see an extra changed file. Fix: In the change description and the report, name send_back.rs as an intentional extra file: the classifier moved down so the brief and the send-back share one definition (round-1 finding 2). No allowed-paths criterion applies.

findings.summary: Some sweep phrases are broad enough to add a needless hint to criteria that are not sweeps
findings.evidence: These phrases appear in ordinary criteria, such as 'no remaining send-backs' or 'nowhere in the loop is a hold added'. A false match only adds one hint sentence and refuses nothing, as the plan says, so the harm is a slightly noisier brief. Fix: Drop 'nowhere' and 'every place', or require 'no remaining' to be followed by a word such as 'hit', 'mention' or 'occurrence'. Then add one near-miss unit case for the narrowed phrase.

findings.summary: The per-attempt detail copy duplicates Candidate.producer_report; the plan says so, but the change description should keep calling it a copy
findings.evidence: Candidate.producer_report (records.rs:863) already stores the final report, and introspect.rs pre_verdict_block reads it. The plan's Decision 1 says the same. Fix: Keep the wording in D191 and the CHANGELOG to 'self-contained copy', as planned, so nobody reads it as the fix for the root cause.

summary: I checked the round-2 plan against the snapshot by reading producer.rs:500-634, send_back.rs, the run/tests.rs helpers and store.rs, and by searching for every reader of Invocation.detail. All three round-1 findings are resolved. (1) The plan now names the brief gap as the one root cause. It cites Candidate.producer_report, pre_verdict_block and commit 81b1374e, and presents the passing-attempt detail as a copy of the candidate's report. (2) is_athena_check_criterion is a pure function at send_back.rs:67, called only within send_back.rs (lines 26, 45, 726-730). It moves next to LEFT_TO_ATHENA (briefs.rs:843), and send_back.rs already imports from athena_context::briefs (line 4), so the hint and the send-back use one classifier. (3) The matchers now compare whole words, and a test checks that 'wrapper' gets no width hint. The producer.rs change fits: line 555 is the bare `break Some(report)`, line 624 already uses `serde_json::to_string(&report)?`, and no code reads a passing producer's detail. The other detail readers (introspect.rs:1725, planning.rs, pin/auditor/steward/hestia/audience) read non-Success outcomes or their own roles' invocations. The criterion-4 seams exist: run_checked_job (tests.rs:5128), editing (3567), PASSES (103), CRITERION (88), the 'read it' evidence (256) and JobRecords.candidate (store.rs:37). The demonstrations would fail on the base tree as described. No refusal rule is added, and the work fits one producer run. Only minor points remain.
